items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to gain elevated access to sensitive resources, leading to customer account takeover and privilege escalation. This flaw has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability (Admin Privileges)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (B2B Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 2 critical
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for numerous Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento allows attackers to write executable files to a store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass, Admin Privileges)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API, named PolyShell, that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Privilege Escalation, Admin Privileges)
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
